properties.name: HQC-256 (Hamming Quasi-Cyclic Key Encapsulation Mechanism)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(n log n) vector polynomial operations via FFT, n=57637, k=256, w=149
properties.algebraic_structure: Quotient ring F_2[X]/(X^57637 - 1) with BCH/Reed-Muller concatenated error correction

properties.name: GF(2)[X] Dense Polynomial Multiplication over Ring X^57637 - 1
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(n log n log log n) via Additive FFT over GF(2^16); Space: O(n) bits
properties.ring_modulus: Polynomial field GF(2^64) quadword vector reductions

properties.name: AVX-512 Vector Carry-Less Multiplication (VPCLMULQDQ / AVX512F)
properties.throughput_bounds: 8 parallel 64x64-bit carry-less multiplications per 512-bit ZMM vector cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform quad 64-bit carry-less multiplications of selected quadwords in zmm2 and zmm3/m512 specified by imm8 selector bits, write 128-bit unreduced results to zmm1
Bitwise XOR of 512-bit vector registers zmm2 and zmm3/m512 into zmm1 for GF(2) polynomial coefficient addition

properties.alignment_requirement: 64-byte boundary alignment for vector memory access (VMOVDQA64)

properties.operation: Drives quasi-cyclic matrix polynomial vector multiplication in HQC encapsulation and decapsulation

properties.vector_width: 8x 64-bit binary polynomial limbs processed per 512-bit SIMD vector instruction

properties.stage: 64x64 to 128-bit polynomial carry-less multiplication step in Karatsuba leaf evaluations
Carry-less coefficient summation step over GF(2) vector quadwords

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 512-bit vector registers containing packed binary polynomial quadword coefficients
Read/Write 512-bit vector registers for carry-less polynomial accumulation
